_comment: Checks a claim may point at. An agent names an entry here; it never supplies
a command, because claims arrive from other people's machines and the host
running them has that person's keys and source on disk.
Convention: a falsifier PASSES when the claim is wrong. A non-zero exit
therefore confirms the defect. Reading this backwards inverts every verdict.
Adding an entry goes through review like any other code.
